statement_made: Brian Parker has a lot of flexibility along the offensive line. A local guy, St. X grad... He can really play all five positions for you.
event_description: Discussing the versatility of local sixth-round pick Brian Parker II during the post-draft recap.

statement_made: When they said it was going to be the Bengals, it's one of the better feelings in the world to be able to go back to your hometown team.
event_description: Reacting to being drafted by his hometown team, the Cincinnati Bengals.

statement_made: Mendoza has the poise and the arm talent to lead this system. We’re building this around him from Day 1.
event_description: First remarks on quarterback Fernando Mendoza after his selection at No. 1 overall by the Raiders.

statement_made: Getting Jonathan Greenard is a huge piece for our defensive front. He’s a relentless worker who fits our culture.
event_description: Discussing the trade to acquire outside linebacker Jonathan Greenard during the 2026 Draft weekend.

statement_made: I’m ready to show Philly why they took me at 20. This city has an energy like nowhere else.
event_description: Introductory press conference after being drafted in the first round by the Eagles.

statement_made: Bringing in Tyler Biadasz is massive for us. Having a veteran center to anchor the middle is huge for our rhythm.
event_description: Commenting on the Chargers' free agency move to strengthen the interior offensive line.

statement_made: The contract doesn't define me. I'm here to work, earn my spot, and help the Vikings win football games.
event_description: Addressing his 'prove-it' deal with Minnesota following his departure from Arizona.

statement_made: Jack (Endries) fits really well with our room to come in here and compete in all phases — special teams, run game, pass game.
event_description: Discussing the draft selection of tight end Jack Endries.

statement_made: I’ve been in that building before and I knew it was the right culture. Ready to earn my stripes on the D-line.
event_description: Reacting to his seventh-round selection by the Bengals.

statement_made: Akheem Mesidor is an explosive athlete. We think his versatility off the edge is something we can use immediately.
event_description: Chargers GM recapping the draft selection of Akheem Mesidor.

statement_made: We wanted tough guys who like to hit. This class, from the tackles to the secondary, has that grit we’re looking for.
event_description: Recapping the Chargers' overall 2026 draft strategy.

statement_made: Coming from Texas Tech, I know about competition. I’m ready to contribute to this Philly defense in any way possible.
event_description: Draft night response after being selected in the seventh round by the Eagles.

statement_made: We’re establishing a standard in Tennessee. It starts with the guys we brought in this weekend.
event_description: Commenting on his first draft class as the head coach of the Titans.

statement_made: Carnell Tate is a special talent. He gives us a level of speed and route running that opens up everything else.
event_description: Titans OC discussing the impact of their new first-round wide receiver.

statement_made: The Dolphins have a great foundation. My goal is to build a defense that plays fast and physical every snap.
event_description: Introductory remarks as the new head coach of the Miami Dolphins.

statement_made: Coach Harbaugh brought me here to set the tone. We’re going to be a physical team that teams hate to play.
event_description: Discussing his move to the Giants in free agency to rejoin John Harbaugh.

statement_made: I’m just here to compete and learn. Tight end in this league is a different beast, but I’m ready.
event_description: First interview after being selected by the Eagles on Day 2 of the draft.

statement_made: I’m grateful for the opportunity in Carolina. I have a lot to prove and I’m ready to get to work.
event_description: Reacting to his one-year 'value' deal with the Panthers.

statement_made: We’ve had Landon (Robinson) in the building before, and we just felt like we needed to add him to the mix.
event_description: Explaining the logic behind taking Landon Robinson in the seventh round.

statement_made: Skol! Ready to anchor this D-line and get after it in the North.
event_description: First public reaction after being selected No. 18 overall by the Vikings.
